syntheticGpuOracle.scope: Exact authored small-scene GPU pixel comparison, including painter order, a second backdrop, isolation, clipping, affine phase, unmanaged outer shadows and unsupported-domain fallback. Managed output uses raw RGBA32F; unmanaged output uses the native RGBA8 format. Not real-document motion or latency acceptance.
syntheticGpuOracle.gate: Every admitted regional component in its native RGBA32F or RGBA8 output format must equal the unchanged wider full-frame GPU crop. A rejected domain must emit the exact legacy same-crop scene and retain raw GPU equality to that scene. Wider-reference differences remain reported for rejected domains and cannot be called newly certified. All output components must be finite; at least one admitted case must reduce allocation extent.

fallback.note: The two rotated legacy fallback cases retain 2 and 886 raw-component differences from the wider full-frame reference. These existing crop-dependent differences are not newly certified or counted as positive wider-reference passes.

priorAttempt.reason: Synthetic fixture contained unreachable nodes; stopped after20completed cases. The v2 fixture removed unreachable synthetic nodes without changing shader arithmetic or relaxing gates.
